name: Decomposition Levels Persist through Maximum Sequences
statement: Fix $k\ge0$. A rank-$r\ge1$ maximum class in $\mathcal D_k$ contains a rank-$(r-1)$ maximum member of $\mathcal D_k$ avoiding any prescribed face fixed on at least $r$ coordinates. A rank-$r<N$ maximum member of $\mathcal D_k$ can be extended within $\mathcal D_k$ to rank $r+1$ while containing any positioned cube of dimension at most $r+1$. Consequently any supplied maximum class, or nested consecutive-rank pair, in $\mathcal D_k$ extends to a complete maximum sequence in $\mathcal D_k$; the same holds for dismantlable maximum classes.
proof: Nested one-coordinate attachments preserve both maximumity and the fixed decomposition level. Induction on rank builds an avoiding predecessor from the full reduction and a lower predecessor; induction on codimension builds a successor from a projection and a larger projected successor containing the prescribed cube. Iterating downward and upward completes the sequence. A finite level containing all supplied dismantlable classes gives the dismantlable version.
